card.name: Opening parenthesis before Bible citations
card.fires_on: The opening bracket or punctuation right after a Bible-story statement, where a scripture reference such as 1 Sam. or John comes next. It fires at the point where a book name is about to be written.

modes.label: Bracket before verse
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a sentence about David or Jesus, just before a scripture reference.

modes.label: Other citation points
modes.description: Punctuation or a partial book abbreviation inside a scripture reference, where more of the citation follows.

card.writes: It promotes the name John and similar name tokens, which fits a Bible book name coming next in a citation.
card.plain: It spots the spot in religious text where a Bible verse reference is about to start.
